about: Cultista Ancestral (cultistV2): hit, second hit and death from the user's sprite sheets (Attachments/Cultist, 2026-10-22), every frame and its timing as drawn, alpha as drawn (no matting, no resampling). The user's counting (from 1): the hit = frames 1-14 of the sheet in Attachments/Cultist; frame 15 (the red slash) is in no clip; the second hit in a row (Golpe Duplo and the like) = frames 16-36; the death = the whole sheet in Attachments/Cultist/Fall (1-36). `first` / `last` below are the JSON's frame_NNN (from 0).
